item.somnium.waking_bell.tooltip: Comes with you into dreams. Use while dreaming to wake up
somnium.dream.drowning_city.objective: Reach the bell atop the sunken cathedral before the water swallows the city.
somnium.dream.shadow_forest.objective: Follow the will-o'-wisps to the Beacon Tree and stand in its light for 5 seconds. The whispers want you to turn around — don't.
somnium.dream.mirror_wastes.objective: Catch your reflection: touch the fleeing mirror 3 times. Your Double follows you and speeds up after every touch.
somnium.dream.collapsing_mine.objective: Find the exit door of the maze — the Exit Compass points the way. Walls collapse and regrow behind your back.
somnium.dream.crimson_feast.objective: The judges will serve 5 dishes. Eat the fresh ones. Burn the spoiled ones (green name, smoke): dish in one hand, lighter in the other, right-click. Then drink the Toast Goblet.
somnium.dream.void_of_eyes.objective: Reach the Door of Waking — or catch 5 gazes: stare straight into a Watcher's eyes for 3 seconds to burn it away.
somnium.dream.dream_within_dream: Dream: A Dream Within a Dream
somnium.dream.falling_planks.objective: Climb the stairwell: flights collapse behind you, rotten teal steps break underfoot. Open the hatch in the ceiling of the top floor.
somnium.dream.mirror_room.objective: Wait for your reflection to break the glass, defeat it and step into the light that opens.
somnium.dream.subtitle: ...you drift into a dream
somnium.outcome.survived_timeout: The dream fades on its own
somnium.outcome.died_in_dream: You died in the dream... and woke in a cold sweat
somnium.dream.interrupted: The dream was cut short — you are back in your bed with all your belongings.
somnium.dream.essence_reward: You wake up clutching Nightmare Essence.
somnium.dream.boundary: The dream will not let you go any further...
somnium.dream.bed_protected: You can't break this bed — someone is sleeping in it!
somnium.dream.bell_woke: The ringing of a bell woke you up!
somnium.hint.drowning.cathedral: A sunken cathedral towers above the city — reach the bell at its top. Enter from any side; inside there is a staircase and a bubble column.
somnium.hint.drowning.pull: The depths are pulling you down!
somnium.hint.drowning.water_high: The water has almost swallowed the city! Hurry to the bell!
somnium.hint.forest.start: The wisps show the way. Don't turn to the whispers.
somnium.hint.forest.channel_start: Stay in the Beacon Tree's light — it is pulling you out of the dream...
somnium.hint.mirror_wastes.start: The wastes are silent. Something is following you.
somnium.hint.mirror_wastes.appeared: A mirror glints somewhere in the wastes. Touch it three times.
somnium.hint.mirror_wastes.touch: Touch %s/%s. The mirror slips away... and the footsteps behind you quicken.
somnium.hint.mirror_wastes.jumped: The mirror dissolves... and glints somewhere else.
somnium.hint.mirror_wastes.shattered: The mirror shatters — the shards melt into the air.
somnium.hint.mirror_wastes.grabbed: The Double touches you — the warmth drains from your body!
somnium.hint.mirror_wastes.direction: The mirror glints somewhere to the %s.
somnium.hint.mine.compass: The Exit Compass is in your inventory — it points to the way out.
somnium.hint.feast.rules: Fresh dish — eat it. Spoiled (green name, smoke) — dish in one hand, lighter in the other, right-click to burn it.
somnium.hint.feast.lighter: The judges hand you a Lighter: use it to burn spoiled dishes.
somnium.hint.feast.dish_taken: The dish is taken. Eat it or burn it.
somnium.hint.feast.ignored: The judges silently take away the untouched dish... They are offended.
somnium.hint.feast.ate_fresh: A fresh dish. The judges nod in approval.
somnium.hint.feast.ate_tainted: The dish was spoiled... The judges laugh.
somnium.hint.feast.burned_tainted: The spoiled dish burns. The judges bow their heads in approval.
somnium.hint.feast.burned_fresh: You burned a fresh dish. The judges hiss.
somnium.hint.feast.goblet: The feast is over. Take a Toast Goblet from the table and drink it to wake up.
somnium.hint.feast.goblet_waiting: A Toast Goblet waits on the table.
somnium.hint.feast.golem: The Flesh Golem has awakened and guards the goblets!
somnium.hint.void.start: You are not alone in this dark. Stare the Watchers straight in the eyes — your gaze burns them. Catch %s gazes or find the Door of Waking.
somnium.hint.dwd.bed: The bed is still where you fell asleep...
somnium.hint.dwd.fell: You fall into the void... and wake up.
somnium.hint.stairwell.start: The stairwell goes up. Steps collapse behind you — keep moving.
somnium.hint.stairwell.keep_moving: Keep moving — the stairs are collapsing.
somnium.hint.stairwell.fell: You fall into the stairwell... and come to on the steps.
somnium.hint.stairwell.last_floor: The top floor. Above is only darkness and a hatch.
somnium.hint.stairwell.hatch: Right-click the ceiling hatch to leave the dream.
somnium.hint.stairwell.light: Light floods your eyes... you are waking up.
somnium.hint.mirror_room.start: The reflection copies your every move... for now.
somnium.hint.mirror_room.exit: The reflection is defeated! An exit mirror opened in the wall — step into the light.
somnium.item.waking_bell.not_dreaming: §7The bell is silent in the waking world — it only works in dreams.
somnium.portal.dissolving: The border of dreams melts beneath your feet...
somnium.portal.arrived: You stepped into the world of dreams. The portal on the platform will take you home.
somnium.portal.back: You surface from the dream back into reality...
somnium.warning.whispers: §7You hear whispers... you need to sleep.
somnium.warning.echoes: §6The border between dream and reality grows thin.
advancements.somnium.first_dream.title: First Dream
advancements.somnium.first_dream.descrip: Enter a dream for the first time
subtitles.somnium.exit_portal: A way out of the dream opens
